project_type: Web app - React + Vite frontend, Go backend
build_system: npm (frontend), go build (backend), Makefile at root
test_framework: Vitest + React Testing Library (frontend), standard Go testing (backend)
test_command: cd frontend && npx vitest --run && cd ../backend && go test ./... -count=1 -timeout=60s
verification_instructions: 1. Run frontend tests: cd frontend && npx vitest --run. 2. Run backend tests: cd backend && go test ./... -count=1 -timeout=60s. 3. Build frontend: cd frontend && npm run build.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network. Node 18 available via nvm. Go 1.25.1 at /usr/local/go/bin/go. No real LLM/pi/WebSocket backend needed - all tests use mocks.
contribution_requirements: Conventional commits (feat:, fix:, etc.). Feature branch -> PR. Tests live next to the component (e.g. Chat.test.tsx). Backend tests in _test.go same package. All tests must use mocks/fakes - NO real tokens consumed.
key_patterns: Frontend: renderWithI18n helper in src/test/i18n-wrapper.tsx wraps components with I18nContext. Global MockWebSocket in src/test/setup.ts auto-opens after setTimeout(0) and records sentMessages[]. Backend: httptest.NewRequest + httptest.NewRecorder pattern. setupTestWorkspace creates temp dirs with sample files.
directory_structure: frontend/src/components/ - React components and their tests. frontend/src/test/ - test setup and helpers. frontend/src/hooks/ - custom hooks. frontend/src/api.ts - HTTP/WebSocket client. backend/internal/api/ - REST handlers. backend/internal/bridge/ - pi/hermes bridge. backend/internal/export/ - PDF/DOCX export.
